title: RoleBolt: Hire Smarter with AI: Your AI co-pilot for faster, smarter hiring | Product Hunt
excerpt: RoleBolt is an AI-powered hiring platform built to help startups and small teams hire faster and smarter. Instead of manually sorting through hundreds of resumes, RoleBolt uses AI to screen candidates, match them to job requirements, and surface the best-fit talent instantly — saving hours of manual work. Built by a team that won 1st prize at the Mesh API Hackathon 2026, RoleBolt is designed for founders and hiring managers who want quality hires without the usual hiring headaches
